name: schema-tasks
description: Delegate to a subagent with a JSON Schema and get back a validated result

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the mod on for new sessions. /schema-tasks on|off overrides it for a session.

maxRepairs.title: Repairs
maxRepairs.description: How many times an invalid subagent reply is sent back with its problems (0 to 5). Each repair is one more subagent request.

maxSchemaBytes.title: Largest schema (bytes)
maxSchemaBytes.description: Largest JSON Schema accepted in an envelope, as JSON text (256 to 262144).

maxResultBytes.title: Largest reply (bytes)
maxResultBytes.description: Largest subagent reply accepted, in UTF-8 bytes (1024 to 4194304); a longer one is invalid.
